title: Muse
tagline: A music NFT rental marketplace where creatives can rent out music and music scores for games
description: This project is about music NFT marketplace where creatives can rent out their songs and musical scores for a prize they set. Either the renter or rentee can end the contract after the duration has expired. It makes use of a new contract that is inherited from the ERC721 which allows for non-collateralized rental
how_its_made: This project is made using solidity programming language aided by hardhat, IPFS for data storage which is the music NFTs that would be uploaded and the Graph for query then deployed to the Polygon blockchain. The project frontend is written in react with the graph implementation done at the frontend.
